summary: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 2.1s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Sergio Perez completing the podium.
Lance Stroll made the biggest climb, from P19 to P5.
Valtteri Bottas had a day to forget, dropping from P7 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised VER (5 second time penalty) and RUS (5 second time penalty).
There were 31 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 276 points over Sergio Perez.
